changes_made.explanation: Added Code Generation task mentioned in abstract, normalized dataset names (2WikiMultihopQA, Natural Questions), removed redundant model variant (Qwen2.5-7B-Base), added description of reasoning traces. Open-domain QA was too broad.
Normalized duplicated metrics and removed redundant parentheses variants. All metrics listed are correct and properly normalized.

Removed incorrect model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is the generation model, not judge model). Removed redundant method description. Refined criteria to the explicit standard mentioned in the LLM-as-a-Judge prompt template.
No human evaluation was conducted in the paper. Kept empty lists as specified in guidelines.

overall_notes: Paper focuses on retrieval-augmented generation for question answering with RL-based process supervision. Extraction was generally accurate but required some normalization and removal of irrelevant items. The paper extensively evaluates generated text using both automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge.
